tasks.title: Multi-Agent Parallel Environment & Context Engine Setup
tasks.description: Initialize Git repository, configure .gitignore, pyproject.toml, .context/ SSOT, agent entrypoint pointers, and agent_hub CLI orchestrator.

tasks.title: Sinhala Tokenizer Fertility & Compression Benchmark Script
tasks.description: Port and standardize the Google Colab token fertility script from the research PDF into scripts/evaluate_tokenizer.py for evaluating Gemma-2/3, Qwen-2.5, and SinLlama on Sinhala and Singlish sentences.

tasks.title: Audio Ear Pipeline (Silero VAD + Faster-Whisper Sinhala STT)
tasks.description: Implement src/sinmate/audio/vad.py and src/sinmate/audio/stt.py using Silero VAD for low-latency voice detection and Faster-Whisper with Sinhala checkpoints.

tasks.title: Brain Engine & Spoken Sinhala Multi-Persona Templates
tasks.description: Implement src/sinmate/brain/personas.py with four dynamic personas (Best Friend, Special Partner, Mother Figure, Teacher) and Ollama LLM client integration.

tasks.title: Mouth Pipeline (Sinhala VITS / Piper TTS Voice Synthesis)
tasks.description: Implement src/sinmate/tts/vits_tts.py to wrap native Sinhala VITS models and stream sentence-by-sentence synthesized audio.

tasks.title: Heart & Memory System (SQLite Fact Store + Spontaneous Heartbeat)
tasks.description: Implement src/sinmate/memory/db.py for conversation history and user profile facts, and src/sinmate/proactive/heartbeat.py for time/silence-based proactive conversation prompts.

tasks.title: Full-Duplex Orchestrator & Barge-In Audio Loop
tasks.description: Integrate Ears, Brain, Mouth, and Heart into an async real-time conversation loop with immediate barge-in interruption capability.

tasks.title: Conversational Sinhala Dataset Generation & SFT/DPO Pipeline
tasks.description: Create data curation and synthetic generation scripts for 5k-10k colloquial spoken Sinhala multi-turn dialogues with conversational fillers.
